summary: Adds read-only `slots windows` (CheckoutPricedServiceOptionsForDateRange {checkoutSessionId, startDate}) listing option, date, time, window and price/savings label with tokens hidden by default, and `slots pick` (UpdateCheckout checkoutUpdates.serviceOptionUpdate {serviceOptionToken}) gated by --yes with a --dry-run preview; it never finalizes. `slots pick` reports updated:true only when data.updateCheckout is present and not an *Error typename (the checkout page's CheckoutCheckoutErrorResponse) with no top-level errors; otherwise it prints updated:false and exits non-zero. --show-tokens also prints tokens in table output.
reason: No CLI way to see or choose delivery windows for an open checkout.

shape_sources.CheckoutPricedServiceOptionsForDateRange: public rspack chunk 93526 (CheckoutCheckoutStepTypesPricedServiceOptionsStep/queries.ts): operation query, variables {checkoutSessionId, startDate yyyy-MM-dd}; response pricedServiceOptions.presentableFormat.layeredOptions[].layeredOption (SingleSelectionOption.serviceOption | ScheduleSelectionOption.dateGroups[].serviceOptionLines[]) with viewSection postCheckoutDateString/TimeString/WindowString and priceFormattedAttributesString; confirmed by a read-only live run
shape_sources.UpdateCheckout serviceOptionUpdate: same chunk: the step's updateCheckout({serviceOptionToken[, selectionMode]}) maps to checkoutUpdates.serviceOptionUpdate
shape_sources.UpdateCheckout: public rspack chunk 93526 (CheckoutFlow store): throws on errors[], requires data.updateCheckout, treats __typename CheckoutCheckoutErrorResponse (errors[]) as updated:false

validated_outcome: Fake-value stub tests: windows is GET-only, hides tokens unless --show-tokens, surfaces service-option error toasts; pick refuses without --yes, sends nothing on --dry-run, sends POST UpdateCheckout with the chosen token and no query string on --yes, never calls FinalizeCheckout. Live: windows listed read-only against the open checkout; pick NOT run live. File name avoids the _windows.go GOOS suffix.
